## Commercial Logistics & Distribution in UAE
- Cold Chain: Guaranteed uninterrupted -18°C temperature with satellite GPS telemetry data loggers.
- Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ): 50 mixed cartons for local UAE delivery; 20ft & 40ft High-Cube reefer containers for GCC/international export.
- Covered Emirates: Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, Umm Al Quwain, Al Ain.
